newsitem.title: USA: McGraw-Hill sees Q4 $300 mln gain from deal.
newsitem.headline: McGraw-Hill sees Q4 $300 mln gain from deal.

text.p: McGraw-Hill Cos Inc said Wednesday it expects to post a pre-tax gain of about $300 million in the fourth quarter from the exchange of its legal publishing unit for Times Mirror Co's higher education group.
Dilution from the exchange in fourth quarter earnings is estimated to be between $0.05 per share and $0.07 per share, excluding one-time charges, it said.
McGraw-Hill said it also sees signs of improvement in its construction information group and some of its advertising-based businesses in the fourth quarter.
The company said that its financial services segment also continues to "show strength."
Excluding the effect of its swap for the Times Mirror properties, the company said it expects to "achieve our growth objectives for the year."
